headline: Director of Strategic Partnerships
about:
InsurePay® is a leading Insuretech SaaS billing and payments platform that ensures accuracy of insurance premiums and offers integrated payments and reconciliations for Agencies, Carriers, MGAs, and insurance technology providers. InsurePay® is empowering Carriers and their partners to allow policyholders to pay only for what they need with real-time system and data-driven accuracy and flexibility, through a feature-rich platform that offers policy holder payments, Carrier PayGo and payables, vendor payables, and claims payments and Agency receivables all integrated to back-office core systems. To learn more, visit www.insurepay.com.

experiences.description: AcordPay provides a suite of payment solutions for collecting premiums, settling with markets and managing claims and refunds.

KixPay’s proprietary online product helps companies keep all of their money when using electronic payments. As CEO, I work with owners, CFOs, controllers and accountants to understand their business and find the best solution for them.

A customer of ours was on the brink of canceling electronic payments (risking the loss of business) as high costs ate into their bottom line. We introduced a system using a system access fee for customers wanting to use electronic payments. The company was able to reduce its costs by six figures and continue to meet the customers needs for payments.

To learn more about what we offer contact me at service@kixpay.com.

Nxgen provides credit card processing and payment service solutions to companies. My role with Nxgen was to provide merchants with the best value and service possible.

In my time with Nxgen I negotiated almost $1B in deals. This gave me an insight into the needs of the different industries and companies I work with today with KixPay. The one thing that was constant across all industries was the need to build strong relationships and keep the customer’s needs as my top focus.

The key to positive results with TaylorMade was to build good relationships with customers and work hard to maintain them. The lessons of trust and integrity continue to serve me today in my current business.
